title: lychnis coeli-rosa
intro: Lychnis coeli-rosa, commonly known as Rose Campion, is a flowering plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rose Campion include its ability to act as an adaptogen, helping the body to adapt to stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Rose Campion include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its health-promoting properties.
